blocks.text:
Media Queries are about defining different style rules for different devices (screens, tablets, mobile phones, etc.). You can learn more
Media Queries in our Media Queries Chapter.

Now we want to set one variable value for screens below 450px wide, and
another variable value for screens above 450px wide.

Here, we first declare a new local variable named --fontsize for the
.container class. We set its value to 20 pixels. Then, we create a
@media rule that says "When the browser's width
is 450px or wider, change the --fontsize variable value of the
.container class to 40px.":
